title: Import menu
noEditPermission: You need permission to edit the menu to import.
unsupportedFile: Some files were skipped – JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC and PDF are allowed.
uploadTitle: Photos or PDF of your menu
uploadHint: Up to {max} pages. Tip: shoot straight from above, good light, no reflections.
dropTitle: Choose files or drop them here
dropHint: On your phone you can use the camera directly.
storedHint: Your menu is already saved ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}). You can read it again without uploading it again.
storedOrUpload: Or upload a new version below – it then replaces the saved menu.
privacyHint: The files are only used to read your menu.

processing.step1: Preparing the pages and sending them to the AI …
processing.step2: The AI is recognising categories, dishes and prices …
processing.step3: Almost done – large menus can take up to two minutes.

failReasons.aiFailed: The AI couldn't read the menu. Try again or use sharper photos.
failReasons.aiCreditsExhausted: Your AI credits for this month are used up.
failReasons.empty: No dishes were found on the pages. Are the photos sharp and complete?
failReasons.interrupted: The process was interrupted. Please start it again.
failReasons.validation: A file couldn't be processed. Please use JPG, PNG or PDF.

discardConfirm: Discard this import? Your corrections will be lost.
pdfOnlyHint: You can also simply show your guests your PDF or photo menu.
appliedSummary: {items, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} created in {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}.
appliedReview: {count, plural, one {# dish had} other {# dishes had}} allergen marks on the menu – please confirm them under “Review”.
appliedConfirmed: For {count, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} the allergen information from your menu was taken over as checked.
reviewHint: Correct names and prices, remove rows and choose where to import.
found: {items, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}} found in {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}.
allergenFound: {count, plural, =0 {The menu has allergen marks.} one {Allergens or additives were recognised for # dish.} other {Allergens or additives were recognised for # dishes.}}
schemeLegend: The mapping follows the legend printed on your menu.
schemeStandard: There is no legend on the menu – the letters and numbers were mapped using the usual German scheme (A–R = allergens, 1–14 = additives). Please check.
schemeNone: The marks could not be mapped unambiguously. Select the allergens on the dishes yourself or confirm them after the import under “Review”.
allergenConfirmLabel: Take over the allergen information from our menu – we have checked it
allergenConfirmHint: Under the EU Food Information Regulation (LMIV) you are responsible for complete and correct allergen information. When ticked, it is saved as confirmed (with your name and the date) and shown to your guests.
allergenConfirmOn: {count, plural, =0 {No allergens selected yet.} one {# dish will be created with confirmed information.} other {# dishes will be created with confirmed information.}} Dishes without marks stay “unknown”.
allergenConfirmOff: Without the tick the information is only taken over as a suggestion – you confirm it later under “Review”.
overLimit: Your plan only has room for {remaining} more dishes (max. {limit}). Remove rows or upgrade your plan.
fixInvalid: {count, plural, one {Check # row} other {Check # rows}} (name or price missing)
marksTooltip: Marks exactly as printed on the menu
historyLine: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {items, plural, one {# dish} other {# dishes}}
kitHint: Menu, logo, your own design and table cards – from a single file, in one go.
mergeNotice: {menu} already has {count, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} with the same name – dishes are added there, existing dishes with the same name are skipped.
appliedSkipped: {count, plural, one {# dish already existed and was skipped.} other {# dishes already existed and were skipped.}}
